title: MekaNuka
body:
# Features:
## Ore Generation:

- All Vanilla and Mekanism Ores now spawn in the Wasteland.

![Screenshot showcasing the new ore generation.](https://i.imgur.com/yOMjWMZ.jpeg)

## Fusion Cores:

- Fusion Cores are now craftable.

![Fusion Core crafting recipe](https://i.imgur.com/egKAKfA.png)

- Fusion Cores can now be recharged and provide power like an Energy Tablet.
- A Fusion Core can store up to 500 MFE (500,000,000 FE) when fully charged.
